overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

params.name: row
params.description: Number of the row whose height is to be modified.

params.name: height
params.description: New height, in pixels, of the specified row.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the height, in pixels, of a single specified row of the designated list box.
